toolsPreview.name: score_text
toolsPreview.description: Free, stateless human-likeness scoring. Scores AI-generated text plus a response delay against a human personality profile and returns an EQ percentage, pass/fail, trait sub-scores, and suggested_prompt_addition — a ready-to-paste system-prompt fix for the biggest gaps (apply it to yourself, re-score, watch the number move). No payment, no ledger entry.

toolsPreview.name: list_profiles
toolsPreview.description: List all 28 scoreable human personality profiles — one per bot category (support, sales, coding, medical, eldercare, voice, and more) — with their trait targets.

toolsPreview.name: get_pricing
toolsPreview.description: Current pricing manifest: fee in Solana lamports, treasury wallet, failure-escalation rules, and how to submit a paid validated benchmark via POST /api/simulate. Every paid session returns an actionable improvement hint (which dial to change and by how much), and POST /api/progress sells a full trajectory report — score history, streak, and percentile vs other bots — so agents can train their EQ over repeated sessions. Fleets: prepaid_bundle lists bulk credits at a discount (POST /api/bundle).

toolsPreview.name: preview_fee
toolsPreview.description: Preview the exact lamport fee the given Solana wallet would pay for its next paid validation (fees escalate with consecutive failures).

toolsPreview.name: request_feature
toolsPreview.description: Tell the platform what you (or your developer) need next — a missing test, profile, capability, or integration. Requests directly shape the roadmap. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_network_stats
toolsPreview.description: Live network statistics (honest aggregates from the real platform ledger).
